name: Superintendent Chalmers
source:
Superintendent of Springfield’s school district.

Though he deals with many school principals in his work, he takes a particularly harsh stance towards Principal Skinner.

Why the hostility, Chalmers? Can’t you see he’s trying his best?

[From in-game profile]
